snippet.title: Order of the Ivy OFFICIAL TRAILER - A modern pixel RPG by Rust Games
snippet.description:
Order of the Ivy is a modern pixel RPG with a silly tone and a serious quest. Wishlist on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4562390/Order_of_the_Ivy/

Kyle is an unemployed, alcoholic, 25 year old loser who lives with his mom. That is, until one fateful night, when he is transported to a far away, strange land: Tucson, Arizona. Here, he finds the world has radically changed, and evil feudal lords who call themselves the Quorum have taken over the world. After the Quorum’s Soldiers personally traumatize him, Kyle joins forces with three best friends, and together they embark on a quest to restore the balance of nature… And end the Quorum once and for all. And Kyle? Well… He makes it annoying the entire way.

#rpg #jrpg #roleplaying #games #indie #pixel #funny #earthbound #undertale #yiik
